answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable stake locked in a vertex of a public reputation graph, where edges record verified work. A new identity starts at the bottom of the graph, like a river carving a canyon: it can only reach high-trust vertices by completing costly, independently checked tasks over time. An attacker creating thousands of fake identities must fund a stake and pay the work cost for each one, and any identity caught attesting falsely loses its stake and its edges, so mass forgery costs far more than the rewards it could extract.
